include(${MAX_SDK_BASE}/script/max-pretarget.cmake)
include_directories("${C74_INCLUDES}")
set(DSP_SRC ${KB_SRC_${PROJECT_NAME}} ${STMLIB_SRC})
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} MODULE kb_knotwork.cpp ${DSP_SRC})
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${KB_ROOT} ${MI})
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TEST=1)
set_source_files_properties(${DSP_SRC} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-include;cstdio;-w")
target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -O2)
include(${MAX_SDK_BASE}/script/max-posttarget.cmake)
